_comment: Pinned Android inputs. The prebuilt Android core and libraries of a release are compiled with exactly this NDK, and the player's machine compiles the generated game with the same one (downloaded by games/dissidia/tools/android_build.py): C++ library and ABI must match. sha1 values are Google's (repository2-3.xml).

tools._comment: Prebuilt inputs of the Android setup app (release/build_android_app.py): the zig that compiles the game ON the phone (static aarch64 Linux, runs on Android as is), the Python that runs the build tools there (python-build-standalone, musl) and Alpine's musl loader it needs. sha256 values are the publishers' (ziglang.org index.json, python-build-standalone SHA256SUMS, alpine latest-releases.yaml).
